description.p: You bite a nearby creature, stunning it and feeding upon it's blood.
Physical Attack vs a creature with blood.
Attack roll: vs. defender DV + level.
You feed per round, for up to 5 rounds.
Taking any action other than passing the turn will end feeding.
Turns before Save-From-Death is active again:
You feed a nearby creature your blood.
Mental attack if not already a ghoul.
Attack roll: vs. defender MA + level.
Grants Stat bonuses to ghouls. Stat bonus increases with EGO mod or Vampirism level (whichever is higher).
Attack bonus increases with EGO mod or Vampirism level (whichever is higher) + player level.
You bring a lost soul back from the dead with the curse of Vampirism.
Resurrection roll vs dead body's level on death.
Resurrection bonus is equal to player level + vampirism level.
